acceptanceCriteria: The runner reads the installed APK digest (pm path + pull/sha256) and refuses or marks incomplete on mismatch.
Unit test with a mismatching digest plus one live witness.
body: Found by CEM platform lane V1-0594 (branch claude/cem10-platform-0594 head 11f6802bb, PR beamfall/corvint#1000, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/platform-2026-10-17/runs/. Requests bind both APK sha256s, but only the lane harness compared the installed base.apk sha256 with the built APK; corvint-test-runner does not. Expected: a mismatch or unobservable installed APK makes the run incomplete.
title: Test runner should verify installed-APK identity against the request-bound APK sha256 itself
